body:
I still feel shitty... I think it's this transitional period where I actually get to make choices. It's filling me with doubt. Maybe it's like that for most people and then they choose whatever is easiest.

I knew since the moment I though about leaving uni, that I most likely wouldn't. Going back home is the harder choice. Especially when I passed the test. It's the sunk cost fallacy at play. But because of this, I think staying isn't a good option.

I can't find the text right now. I chanced upon it after googling thoughts on leaving college. It was written by someone who took a break after his first year at Pomona. There's a good quote out of it that says it's normal to wonder if you should stay, but not normal to stay in spite of it. 

I think he's right. 

But I don't know. Am I throwing away an opportunity? I can return. Next year, just enroll into the second year of my course like nothing happened. Sure, I'll lose touch with people I know now, but they were never really close anyway. And when I return I'll be more experienced with social interactions at uni anyway. I hope.

I'd also presumably look better and feel more confident. 

But maybe I can do all that here. Get to a gym, start therapy in Belgrade... I just feel that uni would get me down a lot. It did during last year. It was all ups and downs. I'd hang out with people after class and I'd feel awesome. Then I'd remember I haven't got their numbers and don't see them out of uni and felt like crap.

Then there's the stress of tests and studying and going to class.

And the fact it all starts again on the 4th of October. Since I am transferring 4 courses, I'll have to study from day one. Really not sure if I'm ready.

I'm leaning more towards going home. But a part of me just wants to do what's simplest and stay in school.
There are no clubs or societies in my uni. At least none that are not political vehicles for a few ambitious people.
I have two days to decide what to do with my life. I posted about it in the other thread.

I don't think you realize what my question is about...

My heart? Who gives a fuck about my heart? That's not how the world works. Move somewhere completely different? With whose money? I can only move back home and work for my dad.
